title.en: Spires of Frosrithe Steampunk Sky City
title.es: Agujas de Frosrithe: ciudad steampunk en el cielo
title.pt: Torres de Frosrithe: cidade steampunk no céu

generated.description: A steampunk sky build of stacked stone-brick spires, cobblestone walls, and oak log and fence details, with a few water features and redstone lamps for lit accents. It is a large, tall structure about 71 blocks in each direction, built from roughly 9,300 blocks, and it reads as a floating or hovering town rather than a single house. The source gives no description of interior contents, and no block entities are present.
